subject.title: refactor(config): config-surface reduction tranche 1 — retire dead keys, dedupe channel schemas, add growth ratchet

question: Should this release preserve the published `TelegramDmThreadReplies` type alias while retiring its runtime configuration key, or intentionally make that external Plugin SDK build break now?
rationale: The implementation can mechanically retain the alias, but accepting a breaking published SDK contract requires maintainer intent and a named release/deprecation boundary.

options.title: Retain a deprecated type-only alias
options.body: Keep the exported alias while doctor and runtime continue enforcing the canonical configuration shape.

options.title: Approve an immediate SDK break
options.body: Remove the alias only with explicit maintainer confirmation of the breaking Plugin SDK contract and its release communication.

recommendation.title: Retain a deprecated type-only alias
recommendation.body: Keep the exported alias while doctor and runtime continue enforcing the canonical configuration shape.

likelyOwner.reason: Owns the current config-reduction series and is the best available routing candidate for the intended SDK boundary.
